notes.title: Cryohazard Bug Fixing 2
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Another patch today, this time with gameplay implications.

These fixes were found by our community of players! If you find any issues while playing, feel free to reach out via Discord for the quickest response.


 Visual bug when collecting the secret Beacons fixed.
 Non-variant enemies of any type excluding Dim Souls can now spawn in car positions 1,2, or 3.

notes.title: Cryohazard Bug Fixing 1
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Small patch today with various fixes for reported bugs over the last few weeks. If you run into any issues while playing, feel free to message me on the discord for the quickest response. And thanks for playing!


Fixed an issue where a Soul Beacon would not appear in the 4th Zone.
Changed the Operator Manual to read that dropping to 0 HP loses just the ability to Accelerate.
Miscellaneous RU localization tweaks.
